title: Generalized Wasserstein Flow Matching: Nested Couplings for Point Cloud Generation
abstract: arXiv:2605.08424v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We formulate flow matching on probability measures over probability measures. Directly from the Wasserstein-on-Wasserstein (WoW) continuity equation, we show that admissible nested outer and inner couplings induce a valid metameasure flow and non-local velocity field. Validity requires neither optimal plans nor a smooth manifold. Practically, this opens up the design space of multisample flow matching: exact Wasserstein plans are distinguished by energy and straightness, while sliced and lazy linear plans yield scalable alternatives. Point-cloud experiments, including controlled Bures-Wasserstein and Euclidean minibatch baselines, demonstrate the resulting geometry-cost trade-off.

translated_title: 广义Wasserstein流匹配：面向点云生成的嵌套耦合
translated_abstract: 我们在“概率测度之上的概率测度”（即元测度）上构造流匹配。直接从Wasserstein-on-Wasserstein（WoW）连续性方程出发，我们证明可容许的嵌套外层与内层耦合能够诱导出有效的元测度流和非局部速度场。这种有效性既不需要最优传输计划，也不需要光滑流形。在实际应用中，这开启了多样本流匹配的设计空间：精确的Wasserstein计划以能量和轨迹直线性见长，而切片（sliced）与惰性线性（lazy linear）计划则提供了可扩展的替代方案。点云实验（包括受控的Bures-Wasserstein与欧氏小批量基线）展示了由此产生的几何与成本之间的权衡。
tldr: 该论文将流匹配推广到概率测度之上的概率测度（元测度）层面，证明只需可容许的嵌套外内耦合（无需最优传输计划或光滑流形）即可诱导有效的元测度流与非局部速度场，从而拓展了多样本流匹配的设计空间，并在点云生成中揭示了几何与成本的权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper generalizes flow matching to probability measures over probability measures (metameasures), showing that admissible nested outer-inner couplings alone—without requiring optimal transport plans or smooth manifolds—induce valid metameasure flows and non-local velocity fields, opening up the design space of multisample flow matching and revealing geometry-cost trade-offs in point cloud generation.
